component: ZenDB v2.0.1 M1 bounded synthetic benchmark
status: IMPLEMENTED, NOT YET EXECUTED: the harness is local-only evidence scaffolding and cannot be reported as a benchmark result until the pinned DFX command succeeds and its output is captured.

runner.networkBoundary: The runner does not invoke `mops install`, because that Mops CLI command performs an unrelated ICP API compatibility call before it resolves the pinned lock. It pings the local replica before any canister creation and every create/build/deploy/call command specifies `--network local`; creation also uses `--no-wallet`.

measuresWhenExecuted: ZenDB-reported query, replace-by-ID, and delete-by-ID instruction counts
ZenDB-reported document and logical-ID-index bytes and entries
bounded caller-to-ZenDB write bytes and one-document recovery-read bytes
doesNotProve: insert or index-create instruction counts, because the pinned API does not report them
archive cross-canister bytes, low-cycle behavior, crash/upgrade recovery, lost replies, duplicate delivery, RBAC bootstrap revocation, or post-upgrade grant audit
a production capacity or instruction budget
